lines.text: Move a clock's hour hand one hour, then two, then three, all the way up to twenty.
lines.caption: Move a clock's hour hand one hour, then two, then three, all the way up to twenty.

lines.text: Where does it stop? You won't need to spin it by hand!
lines.caption: Where does it stop? You won't need to spin it by hand!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's go around the clock.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's go around the clock.

lines.text: Here's the question.
lines.caption: Here's the question.

lines.text: The hour hand of a clock points to three.
lines.caption: The hour hand of a clock points to three.

lines.text: Tom moves it forward one hour, then two hours, then three hours, and so on.
lines.caption: Tom moves it forward one hour, then two hours, then three hours, and so on.

lines.text: He finishes with a move of twenty hours.
lines.caption: He finishes with a move of twenty hours.

lines.text: To which number does the hour hand point at the end?
lines.caption: To which number does the hour hand point at the end?

lines.text: Here are the five choices.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices.

lines.text: There are twenty moves, and each one is one hour longer than the last.
lines.caption: There are twenty moves, and each one is one hour longer than the last.

lines.text: Here's a key fact. Twelve hours is one full turn.
lines.caption: Here's a key fact. Twelve hours is one full turn.

lines.text: The hand lands right back where it started.
lines.caption: The hand lands right back where it started.

lines.text: We want the number the hand points to at the very end.
lines.caption: We want the number the hand points to at the very end.

lines.text: Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Let's add up all the moves first.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Let's add up all the moves first.

lines.text: We need one plus two plus three, all the way to twenty.
lines.caption: We need one plus two plus three, all the way to twenty.

lines.text: Pair them up. One and twenty make twenty-one. Two and nineteen make twenty-one too.
lines.caption: Pair them up. One and twenty make twenty-one. Two and nineteen make twenty-one too.

lines.text: Twenty numbers make ten pairs. Ten times twenty-one is two hundred ten hours.
lines.caption: Twenty numbers make ten pairs. Ten times twenty-one is two hundred ten hours.

lines.text: Twelve hours is a full turn. Two hundred ten divided by twelve is seventeen, remainder six.
lines.caption: Twelve hours is a full turn. Two hundred ten divided by twelve is seventeen, remainder six.

lines.text: Seventeen full turns bring the hand right back to three. They don't change anything!
lines.caption: Seventeen full turns bring the hand right back to three. They don't change anything!

lines.text: Only the six leftover hours matter. Count six more from three.
lines.caption: Only the six leftover hours matter. Count six more from three.

lines.text: The hand ends at nine. That's Choice D!
lines.caption: The hand ends at nine. That's Choice D!

lines.text: Here's another way. Throw away full turns as you go.
lines.caption: Here's another way. Throw away full turns as you go.

lines.text: One and eleven make twelve. So do two and ten, three and nine, four and eight, and five and seven.
lines.caption: One and eleven make twelve. So do two and ten, three and nine, four and eight, and five and seven.

lines.text: And the move of twelve is a full turn by itself.
lines.caption: And the move of twelve is a full turn by itself.

lines.text: From the first twelve moves, only the six is left. So far, the hand goes from three to nine.
lines.caption: From the first twelve moves, only the six is left. So far, the hand goes from three to nine.

lines.text: Each move from thirteen to twenty is a full turn, plus one to eight extra hours.
lines.caption: Each move from thirteen to twenty is a full turn, plus one to eight extra hours.

lines.text: One through eight adds to thirty-six. That's three more full turns!
lines.caption: One through eight adds to thirty-six. That's three more full turns!

lines.text: So the last eight moves change nothing. The hand stays at nine.
lines.caption: So the last eight moves change nothing. The hand stays at nine.

lines.text: When would you pick this way? When you'd rather not add big numbers.
lines.caption: When would you pick this way? When you'd rather not add big numbers.

lines.text: Now the traps. Choice B, six, is the leftover. It counts from twelve, but the hand started at three!
lines.caption: Now the traps. Choice B, six, is the leftover. It counts from twelve, but the hand started at three!

lines.text: Choice A, three, says the hand ends where it started. That needs whole turns only.
lines.caption: Choice A, three, says the hand ends where it started. That needs whole turns only.

lines.text: But two hundred ten isn't a multiple of twelve.
lines.caption: But two hundred ten isn't a multiple of twelve.

lines.text: Choices C and E, seven and ten, would need four or seven leftover hours. But the leftover is six.
lines.caption: Choices C and E, seven and ten, would need four or seven leftover hours. But the leftover is six.

lines.text: Start at three, add six, and land on nine.
lines.caption: Start at three, add six, and land on nine.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? This time the hand starts at eight.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? This time the hand starts at eight.

lines.text: It moves one hour, then two, then three, finishing with a move of sixteen hours.
lines.caption: It moves one hour, then two, then three, finishing with a move of sixteen hours.

lines.text: Where does it point?
lines.caption: Where does it point?

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. Pair them up: one and sixteen make seventeen, and there are eight pairs.
lines.caption: Let's check. Pair them up: one and sixteen make seventeen, and there are eight pairs.

lines.text: Eight times seventeen is one hundred thirty-six.
lines.caption: Eight times seventeen is one hundred thirty-six.

lines.text: One hundred thirty-six divided by twelve is eleven, remainder four.
lines.caption: One hundred thirty-six divided by twelve is eleven, remainder four.

lines.text: Count four hours from eight: nine, ten, eleven, twelve.
lines.caption: Count four hours from eight: nine, ten, eleven, twelve.

lines.text: The hand points to twelve!
lines.caption: The hand points to twelve!

lines.text: Eight plus four lands on the twelve itself.
lines.caption: Eight plus four lands on the twelve itself.

lines.text: If you got twelve, fantastic work!
lines.caption: If you got twelve, fantastic work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: Add up all the moves. Full turns of twelve change nothing, so keep only the remainder.
lines.caption: Add up all the moves. Full turns of twelve change nothing, so keep only the remainder.

lines.text: Then count that many from where you started.
lines.caption: Then count that many from where you started.

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep spinning, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep spinning, and I'll see you next time!
